prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / DRINK]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [PRESS / SCOOP / SMEAR / LAYER / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European café branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the typography and food as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction must visibly change the structure of the letters through believable physics.

Examples: PRESS, food weight compresses and locally deforms the typography; SCOOP, a real scoop removes material directly from a letter, leaving a matching cavity and revealing edible material inside; SMEAR, a knife drags food across the type, causing localized lateral stretching and shear only along the contact zone; LAYER, the typography contains real food layers, and one structural layer is physically pulled out and offset.

Keep the interaction localized, clear, and physically believable, untouched parts of the typography should remain hard, clean, geometric, and readable, use only one main physical mechanism per poster, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, or digital-looking distortion.

Add small editorial information such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], use strong scale contrast rather than traditional menu rows, avoid long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, or template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, or prices, keep the color system minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, and instantly understandable at thumbnail size, the key idea is simple: food does not decorate the typography, food physically changes it.

Create a 9:16 ultra-realistic close-up portrait of an adult young woman in strong natural sunlight.

Make the sunlight a major part of the image: direct, uneven, slightly harsh, with bright highlights falling across the hair, face, shoulders, and collarbone. Allow small areas of controlled highlight clipping while keeping facial structure and skin detail visible.

Hair should feel especially alive in the light—natural volume, loose strands, flyaways, fine individual hairs, and subtle movement. Backlit or side-lit strands should glow clearly against the darker background, with realistic variation in tone rather than a flat solid hair color.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Prompt
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is A from <Picture 1>, the boastful caster.
<Subject 2> is B from <Picture 2>, who calmly releases the binding.
Preserve both identities, faces, hair, costumes, accessories and art styles. Scale their complete designs to equal standing height, maintaining each character's internal proportions.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1). Reference its vocal identity and pitch range, not its recorded words.
summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 15-second Japanese 2D anime comedy. A binds B with a glowing cord connected to a retractable reel in A's hand. B presses its button. The cord rewinds, and its end tab lightly taps A's finger. End on A's silent, stunned face. Use the selected aspect ratio.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (Shots 1-4): fully_preserved - retain identity and design at the established equal-height scale, with new actions.
<Subject 2> (Shots 1-3): fully_preserved - retain identity and design at the same standing height as A.
<Audio 1>: reference - voice timbre for A's opening line only.
Reference images provide character identity and style only, not poses, backgrounds or relative size.
detailed_description:
Hand-drawn 2D anime, clean lines, cel shading, fluid animation. Exactly two characters in a level stone courtyard in warm daylight.
A and B have equal standing height, measured from soles to skull tops, excluding ornaments. Neither grows or shrinks between shots. Establish both full bodies at the same distance from a level camera, feet on the same ground line and skull tops aligned. Preserve this scale during movement and close-ups. B must not appear taller or larger overall.

One palm-sized black-and-yellow retractable measuring reel has one large top button, one outlet and a golden cord ending in a small rounded tab. A holds it in her LEFT hand for the entire video. B touches only the button with her RIGHT index finger. The reel is never transferred or duplicated. No readable markings.
[Shot 1] A full-body two-shot shows <Subject 1> screen-left and <Subject 2> screen-right, facing each other about one meter apart. Both stand upright at equal depth, visibly the same height. A holds the reel at waist level in her left hand and gestures with her right. The glowing cord winds three separate turns around B's lower torso. B's arms, hands, neck and legs remain free. Show the strand connecting the loops to A's reel.

From 0.3 to 2.8 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1) proudly declares using the voice timbre of <Audio 1>, [Japanese] このいとからは、にげられない! Synchronize A's lips, then close them. A magical whoosh accompanies the binding. By four seconds, the glow fades enough to reveal the physical cord. A smiles smugly. B follows the cord with her eyes toward the reel.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, cut to a level medium two-shot showing both faces, B's right hand and A's left hand holding the reel. Keep their equal body scale. B takes one small sideways step toward A, not toward the filming camera. The connecting strand slackens. A keeps holding the reel with its button facing up. At about six seconds, B presses the button once with her right index finger. A dry click sounds. B withdraws her hand immediately. A's left index finger rests beside the outlet. Music stops at the click.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, cut to a steady medium shot including B's torso and A's reel. The spring pulls the cord into the outlet with a mechanical whirr. Show all three turns unwinding around B's costume in sequence. The strand stays continuous; it does not dissolve, break or pass through her body. B stands still with hands clear. The reel stays in A's left hand.
After the last loop clears B, the remaining length retracts. Keep A's reel and the returning tab visible. At about ten seconds, the rounded tab lightly clips A's left index finger beside the outlet with one plastic tick, then rests against the reel. The cord is fully retracted. A flinches silently. No wound, violent whipping or collision between characters.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.500, cut to a medium close-up of <Subject 1>'s face and hands. Her left palm still holds the reel; her right hand gently holds the tapped left index finger. Her smile vanishes. Eyes widen, pupils become small, eyebrows rise. Her lips part once and remain still. She looks toward B with her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression. No blush, crying or exaggerated pain. Slowly push in, keeping the held finger near the frame's bottom. Hold the final full second. End directly on A.

overall_soundscape:
Faint courtyard wind, one magical whoosh, one footstep, one button click, a rewind whirr and one plastic tick. A speaks only the sentence in Shot 1. B is completely silent. After three seconds, no speech, gasps, grunts, screams, laughter or vocal breaths. If B's voice reference is attached, leave it unused. No narration or additional voices.
non_diegetic_music:
Solemn low strings and restrained percussion during the opening. Stop at the button click. Keep the rewind and tap clearly audible, then only faint ambience. No choir, comedy sting or canned laughter.

No text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, photorealism, 3D look, chibi, extra people, extra limbs, fused hands, costume changes or changing character scale.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】  
【主视觉主体】  
【中文核心字】  
【中文标题】  
【英文标题】  
【对角关系】人物跨角 / 斜向负空间 / 自然边界 / 地形切面 / 其他  
【主色】  
【强调色】  
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 **East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Design** 气质的现代竖版海报，核心采用“对角构图”。不要简单把图片或文字旋转 45°，而是先建立一条隐形的斜向主轴，让主体、自然边界、色域或负空间从一个角向另一个角推进，使整个版面的视觉重量产生明确方向。

根据【主题】选择一种最适合的对角机制：人物题材可以让身体动作从左下伸向右上，以姿态本身形成视觉主轴；极简题材可以让大片斜向负空间成为真正主体，只加入极小人物作为尺度参照；自然题材可以利用海岸线、水面、山坡、光影边界等真实斜向关系切分画面；地形或建筑题材可以用大面积切面、尺度差和留白形成距离感。每张只突出一种主要机制，不要把人物、斜线、色块和复杂透视全部叠在一起。

对角构图应依赖“大关系”，不是小装饰。主体或主要色域最好占画面约 45%–65%，同时保留一块明显的安静区域，使画面形成“密到疏”“近到远”或“重到轻”的方向变化。避免平均 50% 对半切，也不要使用标准机械的 45° 斜线，可以让斜向角度略微偏移，使版式更自然、更有编辑感。

Typography 必须保持稳定，与动态画面形成对抗。中文核心字可以放大、贴边、局部裁切，但保持水平或竖直；英文标题使用 Serif、Grotesk 或 Condensed Sans，小信息使用 Neutral Grotesk。不要让所有文字跟随斜线倾斜。建议形成“图像负责动，文字负责稳”的关系，并允许主体与文字产生一处轻微穿插、遮挡或压边。

整体色彩控制在 2–3 个主要层级，以冷白、暖白、黑、灰或单一高纯强调色为主。强调色可以用于短线、节点、局部标题或主体区域，但不要平均散布。保持现代、克制、干净，减少传统装饰和模板化说明文字。信息密度以中等为宜，至少保留约 25%–35% 有效留白。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到强烈的对角大形，第二眼理解主体或边界如何形成方向，第三眼发现尺度、负空间和文字之间的关系，最后再阅读标题与少量信息。整体效果应像真实的现代展览海报、摄影专题、文化视觉或设计年鉴案例，而不是普通图片斜着摆放。

避免：所有元素都倾斜、标准 45° 模板、平均对半切、斜向时间轴、PPT 感、满版说明文字、无意义英文、复杂传统装饰、科技 HUD、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

prompts.text:
Sunkissed glow, sharp wings, soft hoodie.

Prompt: **Use my photo as a basis.**  
**Photorealistic 9:16 photo.**  

**APPEARANCE:** smooth skin tone with a moist glow, natural highlighter on the cheekbones and bridge of the nose. neat eyebrows, expressive eye and lip makeup: long arrows extending to the temples. False eyelashes are glued in bunches, creating a "prickly" effect in the style of anime (manga lashes). there are bright highlights of highlighter in the inner corners of the eyes. Her plump lips were painted with a dusty pink gloss. the contour of the lips is slightly blurred and slightly goes beyond the natural boundaries (the effect of "kissed lips"). hair below the waist, thick. they fall freely forward, framing the face. they have a well-groomed appearance and a healthy shine with a natural texture, individual thin strands are visible.  

**The nails are very long, pointed ("stilettos"), painted with a milky translucent varnish.**  

**THE IMAGE:** the hair is gathered in a loose, careless bun on top of the head, several thin strands have escaped and are fluttering in the wind, creating the effect of slight carelessness and movement. a small stud earring is visible at the temple, neat and shiny; on the neck is a thin chain, barely noticeable, lying along the line of the collarbone. The hoodie is a light gray (melange) shade of thick jersey, with the hood resting loosely on the shoulders. There is a large dark patch/embroidery with a graphic element or a letter logo on the chest, and a loose sleeve.  

**POSE:** a pose close to a "selfie": the hand is raised to the face or head, the elbow is directed towards the camera, which creates a feeling of comfort and light thoughtfulness.  

**FORESHORTENING:** slightly from below and from the side — the camera is pointing upwards, with most of the sky in the background; this point of view lengthens the neck and emphasizes the chinline and hood.  

**SHOOTING:** natural photo on an iPhone 17 pro smartphone, slight imperfection of the frame, the effect of a live moment. high quality, high texture detail.  

**BACKGROUND:** clear blue sky without clouds, on which a yellow pole with stretched wires rises vertically — an urban street detail that adds to the geometry of the composition. The tops of buildings or fences are visible from below and at the edges of the frame, but they are blurred and do not distract attention from the figure. the absence of dense urban noise in the frame makes the background open and airy.  

**LIGHTING:** warm low sunlight (late evening or early morning): The rays at an angle highlight the side of the face, the upper part of the shoulder and the texture of the hoodie in a soft golden tone. The contrast between brightly lit areas and calm shadows creates volume, but the shadows remain soft, without harsh drama. The highlights on the earring and individual strands of hair accentuate the texture and add vivacity to the frame.  

**THE ATMOSPHERE** is laconic, calm and slightly intimate — like a moment of pause outside on a sunny, cool day. aesthetics of urban minimal sports: convenience, simple forms, absence of obsessive demonstrativeness. The presence of wind, warm sun and open sky gives a feeling of lightness, freedom and relaxed mood.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【品牌名称】：{例如：尾巴日和}  
【英文名称】：{例如：TAIL & DAY PET CLUB}  
【品牌类型】：{例如：宠物生活方式品牌 / 花店 / 餐饮 / 书店}  
【品牌关键词】：{例如：温暖、自然、亲切、手作感}  
【核心视觉意象】：{例如：尾巴、太阳、宠物陪伴}  
【主色建议】：{例如：奶油黄、深棕、砖红、鼠尾草绿}  
【顶部背景色】：{根据品牌气质填写}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请为以上品牌生成一张完整的「Brand to Logo」品牌 Logo 概念探索设计稿。核心不是简单生成四个相似 Logo，而是围绕同一个品牌名称、行业属性和核心概念，提出四条真正不同的视觉设计路线。

最终画面固定为 9:16 竖版。顶部品牌输入区严格占整个画面高度的 30%，底部 Logo 展示区严格占 70%，无论品牌名称长短都不能改变这个比例；名字较长时缩小字号，不扩大顶部区域。底部 70% 再严格划分为 2×2 四个等大区域，只使用非常浅、非常细的虚线分隔，不绘制外围边框。

【顶部品牌区】

顶部只是品牌原始信息的引入区，不是主视觉海报。使用【顶部背景色】，加入极轻微的纸张、和纸、包装纸、丝网印刷颗粒或与品牌相关的低对比暗纹，只增加质感，不形成复杂插画。

顶部只保留三层信息：

BRAND TO LOGO

【品牌名称】

【英文名称】

品牌名称使用正常、清晰、现代的印刷字体，不提前进行 Logo 化、手写化或图形变形。不要加入口号、品牌说明、大量小英文、编号、印章、辅助图标或复杂光影，让视觉重点自然落到下方四个 Logo 方案。

【底部 Logo 展示区】

底部统一使用 Warm Ivory 暖米白纸张背景，只保留轻微天然纸纹。四个 Logo 都需要围绕【品牌类型】【品牌关键词】【核心视觉意象】展开，保持品牌核心一致，但设计方法必须明显不同。

每个 Logo 都应该是一套完整、可以真实用于门店、包装、标签、社交头像、名片或周边商品的品牌标识，而不是完整插画、海报或装饰图。

每个方案控制在 1–3 个主要颜色以内，优先使用【主色建议】。避免高饱和杂色、复杂渐变、3D、金属浮雕、玻璃质感和商业 mockup。

【Mascot｜吉祥物型】

从品牌名称、行业或核心意象中设计一个高度概括的角色或拟人化主体。角色需要拥有清楚的大轮廓和强记忆点，但不要做成复杂动漫人物或完整场景插画。

让角色本身与品牌概念发生关系，例如抱着产品、隐藏在物体后面、与核心植物或动物融合。搭配完整的【品牌名称】字标和较小的【英文名称】，整体亲和、有故事感、适合社交传播。

【Emblem｜意象徽章型】

不依赖完整人物，而是从【核心视觉意象】中提炼 2–3 个最重要的元素，组合成一个集中、平衡、容易缩小识别的品牌徽章。

优先使用负空间、环绕、上下叠合、局部包围或图形共形，让不同元素真正融合成一个标志，而不是简单把几个小图标并排放在一起。搭配品牌字标，形成完整稳定的 Logo 系统。

【Type-led｜字形创意型】

以【品牌名称】本身作为核心设计对象。分析中文字或英文字母中最有视觉潜力的笔画、结构、偏旁、负空间和字母轮廓，让品牌的核心意象从文字内部自然生长出来。

可以进行省笔、共享笔画、延长、切割、局部替换、负空间重构或字形融合，但必须保留基本识别度。

不要在普通字体旁边额外贴一个图标。重点是让“文字本身就是 Logo”，形成更现代、更聪明、更具有专业平面设计感的方案。

【Stamp｜开放式手作印记型】

设计一款具有手刻、版画、店章或包装印记气质的 Logo，但不要使用规整完整的方框，也不要把所有内容塞进封闭椭圆。

使用不完整边界、开放弧线、自然笔触、品牌核心图形或文字共同形成松散的视觉范围。元素可以轻微错位，边缘允许少量自然缺墨和手工印刷不均，让整体具有呼吸感。

Stamp 必须保持清楚的主次关系和充分留白。不要因为追求“印章感”而变得死板、密集或难以实际使用。

四款必须共享同一个品牌世界观、核心意象和基础配色，但不能只是同一个 Logo 换四种画风或四种排版。

不要加入 A/B/C/D 等编号。底部不要添加口号、解释句或多余信息。不要生成包装 mockup、真实门店场景或完整插画。

最终画面要像一张成熟、干净、有方法差异、有真实品牌设计价值的专业 Logo Exploration Sheet。

prompts.text:
https://promptsref.com/tool/AI-Image-Generator/share/87d5119e2c06d52af74fecba2d705046

Create one independent high-end editorial poster for each uploaded photo. Do not combine multiple photos into a collage. Each photo must be processed and output as a separate poster.

OVERALL FORMAT

Strict 3:4 vertical composition.

Divide the canvas horizontally into two exactly equal sections, with a precise 1:1 height ratio.

The top half occupies exactly 50% of the canvas.

The bottom half occupies exactly 50% of the canvas.

The two sections should feel visually connected as one refined art publication cover.

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH

Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible.

Keep the main composition, subjects, identity, facial features, body proportions, poses, expressions, clothing, objects, and spatial relationships unchanged.

Preserve the realistic photographic texture, natural lighting, shadows, atmosphere, and original color mood.

Apply only subtle, sophisticated editorial color grading, creating the feeling of a premium magazine photograph, contemporary art book, or high-end independent publication.

The image should remain photorealistic and authentic, never overly retouched or artificially stylized.

If necessary to fit the 3:4 composition naturally, extend the sky, ground, walls, or surrounding environmental background.

Background extension must feel seamless and photographic.

Never stretch, distort, reshape, replace, or alter the main subject.

BOTTOM HALF — MINIMAL HAND-DRAWN PAPER ILLUSTRATION

Extract the most recognizable visual elements from the original photograph and reinterpret them as a minimalist hand-drawn paper-cover illustration.

Preserve:

The most recognizable subject

Essential silhouette and proportions

Key pose or gesture

Important objects

The core narrative relationship between people and objects

Highly simplify the image. Remove unnecessary details and retain only the visual information needed for immediate recognition.

Use:

Delicate, slightly imperfect hand-drawn lines

A small number of bold, clearly defined acrylic-style flat color shapes

Rough paper texture

Visible handmade brush marks

Slightly irregular, organic edges

Subtle imperfections that make it feel genuinely handmade

The main illustrated subject should be small, centered, and carefully composed, occupying approximately 10–20% of the bottom half.

Leave a large amount of negative space around the illustration.

The background should primarily resemble:

Rough white paper

Warm off-white paper

Pale natural paper

Minimal editorial book-cover stock

Use only a few lines or small color shapes to suggest the surrounding environment.

COLOR PALETTE

Extract the dominant colors directly from the original photograph.

Compress the palette into no more than 4 main colors.

Keep the colors restrained, sophisticated, and harmonious.

Use bold but controlled flat color blocks.

Avoid excessive color variation.

Preserve subtle paper grain and handmade brush texture.

The illustration should visually feel like a simplified color interpretation of the photograph.

TYPOGRAPHY

A small amount of simple typography may be included when appropriate.

Possible elements:

A short title

Keyword

Object name

Location

Year

Number

Short phrase

Text should be minimal, understated, and editorial.

Typography should naturally interact with the large areas of negative space and the small illustration, evoking:

Art book covers

Independent publishing

Contemporary editorial design

Thoughtful children's picture books

Do not force text into the composition if it does not naturally fit the photograph.

VISUAL LANGUAGE

The final poster should feel:

Quiet · Poetic · Refined · Minimal · Innocent · Relaxed · Artistic · Thoughtful · High-recognition · Premium

The visual concept should be:

“A small subject surrounded by a large amount of empty space.”

The result should resemble a carefully designed independent art publication cover, rather than a commercial advertisement.

AVOID

Do not use:

Colored-pencil aesthetics

Crayon textures

Bleeding watercolor

Pure line-art illustration

Complex realistic illustration

Heavy oil-painting effects

Smooth polished digital illustration

3D rendering

Glossy 3D textures

Commercial cartoon aesthetics

Cute commercial character design

E-commerce advertising aesthetics

Generic poster templates

Excessive decorative elements

Busy compositions

Excessive typography

FINAL ART DIRECTION

The top half should feel like a beautiful, authentic editorial photograph.

The bottom half should feel like a small, handmade visual poem derived from that photograph.

The two halves should clearly belong to the same visual story, while maintaining a strong contrast between photographic realism above and minimal handmade illustration below.

Prioritize recognition, restraint, negative space, material texture, subtle imperfection, editorial sophistication, and artistic storytelling over decorative complexity.

prompts.text:
Sunkissed glow, sharp wings, soft hoodie.

Prompt: **Use my photo as a basis.**  
**Photorealistic 9:16 photo.**  

**APPEARANCE:** smooth skin tone with a moist glow, natural highlighter on the cheekbones and bridge of the nose. neat eyebrows, expressive eye and lip makeup: long arrows extending to the temples. False eyelashes are glued in bunches, creating a "prickly" effect in the style of anime (manga lashes). there are bright highlights of highlighter in the inner corners of the eyes. Her plump lips were painted with a dusty pink gloss. the contour of the lips is slightly blurred and slightly goes beyond the natural boundaries (the effect of "kissed lips"). hair below the waist, thick. they fall freely forward, framing the face. they have a well-groomed appearance and a healthy shine with a natural texture, individual thin strands are visible.  

**The nails are very long, pointed ("stilettos"), painted with a milky translucent varnish.**  

**THE IMAGE:** the hair is gathered in a loose, careless bun on top of the head, several thin strands have escaped and are fluttering in the wind, creating the effect of slight carelessness and movement. a small stud earring is visible at the temple, neat and shiny; on the neck is a thin chain, barely noticeable, lying along the line of the collarbone. The hoodie is a light gray (melange) shade of thick jersey, with the hood resting loosely on the shoulders. There is a large dark patch/embroidery with a graphic element or a letter logo on the chest, and a loose sleeve.  

**POSE:** a pose close to a "selfie": the hand is raised to the face or head, the elbow is directed towards the camera, which creates a feeling of comfort and light thoughtfulness.  

**FORESHORTENING:** slightly from below and from the side — the camera is pointing upwards, with most of the sky in the background; this point of view lengthens the neck and emphasizes the chinline and hood.  

**SHOOTING:** natural photo on an iPhone 17 pro smartphone, slight imperfection of the frame, the effect of a live moment. high quality, high texture detail.  

**BACKGROUND:** clear blue sky without clouds, on which a yellow pole with stretched wires rises vertically — an urban street detail that adds to the geometry of the composition. The tops of buildings or fences are visible from below and at the edges of the frame, but they are blurred and do not distract attention from the figure. the absence of dense urban noise in the frame makes the background open and airy.  

**LIGHTING:** warm low sunlight (late evening or early morning): The rays at an angle highlight the side of the face, the upper part of the shoulder and the texture of the hoodie in a soft golden tone. The contrast between brightly lit areas and calm shadows creates volume, but the shadows remain soft, without harsh drama. The highlights on the earring and individual strands of hair accentuate the texture and add vivacity to the frame.  

**THE ATMOSPHERE** is laconic, calm and slightly intimate — like a moment of pause outside on a sunny, cool day. aesthetics of urban minimal sports: convenience, simple forms, absence of obsessive demonstrativeness. The presence of wind, warm sun and open sky gives a feeling of lightness, freedom and relaxed mood.

Minecraft AI Filter prompt:

Use the uploaded real photo as the source.

Keep the people realistic and recognizable. Preserve their identity, pose, clothing, body proportions, hair, and overall photographic feel. Do not turn the people into full Minecraft characters.

Transform the surrounding environment into a strongly unified Minecraft-style voxel world. Rebuild the trees, plants, ground, beach, cliffs, ocean, clouds, furniture, buildings, and other visible scene elements with clear blocky geometry, pixel-like textures, and a solid 3D voxel look.

Keep the original composition, perspective, lighting direction, and subject placement, so the filtered result still clearly matches the source photo.

Important details:

* water should look flatter and more pixel-based
* vegetation should feel blocky and clean
* terrain and cliffs should have stepped voxel structure
* clouds should be light, simple, and blocky
* the environment should feel fully rebuilt in Minecraft, not just lightly stylized

Output a single vertical comparison image:
top half = original photo
bottom half = Minecraft-filtered result

Do not add any text, labels, watermark, logo, border, or decorative elements.

prompts.text:
兄弟，我发现了一个特别容易出神图的海报公式。

真的不是再加几个“高级感、电影感、杂志感”这种废词。

我最近在研究这类复古海报，突然发现它最爽的地方是：

把一幅名画“拆了”，只拿走它最值钱的东西。

不是复刻《雾海上的漫游者》《睡莲》《神奈川冲浪里》，而是只提炼：

巨大英文单词 + 极小人物 + 大面积留白 + Swiss 排版 + 70 年代旧印刷质感。

一下就从“名画二创”变成了真正的概念设计海报。

提示词母版也直接送了，自己替换括号就行👇

3:4 conceptual retro editorial poster, inspired by 【名画母题/艺术流派】 but not directly reproducing it, reinterpret its composition, visual motif and emotional atmosphere as a modern conceptual poster.

Large 【cream / ivory】 negative space on aged uncoated paper, giant uppercase word “【主标题】” in 【颜色】 bold condensed sans-serif typography, interacting with the scene through fog, water, architecture or foreground elements.

Lower portion shows 【重新设计后的场景】 with a very small 【人物 / 小船 / 房子 / 物体】 as a scale anchor, creating a strong contrast between monumental typography and tiny human presence.

Swiss modernist editorial layout, tiny ISSUE / DATE / POSTER SERIES metadata, thin rule lines, small poetic quote, bottom caption and issue number.

Muted 2–4 color palette, 1970s European art magazine aesthetic, vintage offset printing, screen print texture, halftone grain, faded ink, subtle scratches, slight misregistration, aged paper fibers, matte finish.

minimal, poetic, conceptual, museum poster, elegant, restrained, quiet but visually striking.

no QR code, no watermark, no logo, no mockup, no social media overlay, no glossy commercial style, no neon cyberpunk, no 3D metallic text, no clutter
这套东西我越玩越觉得有意思。

AI 画图最怕的是“想画得漂亮”，一旦开始用设计逻辑控制它，味道马上就不一样了。

Prompt:

[Name]: {e.g. Amelia Rose}  
[Top Background Color]: {e.g. dusty blue, muted rose, forest green, deep burgundy, warm ochre}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a vertical 9:16 "Name to Signature" design sheet that transforms one plain English name into four clearly different handwritten signature concepts.

Use two sections. The top 40% shows the original typed name, and the bottom 60% shows four signature designs.

For the top section, use the selected muted background color with subtle paper or fabric texture and a soft natural shadow. Add small widely spaced text at the top:

NAME TO SIGNATURE

Display the original name in the center using a large, clean neutral sans-serif font such as Helvetica, Arial, Inter, or a similar modern typeface. This must look like normal typed text, not handwriting. Keep the layout minimal and do not add extra slogans or decorative copy.

For the bottom section, use a warm ivory paper background with very subtle grain. Divide it into a clean 2×2 grid using faint thin dashed lines, with no outer border.

Create four large black handwritten signatures for the same name. They must be noticeably different in silhouette, rhythm, stroke direction, abstraction, and personality. Do not simply generate four similar cursive versions.

Use realistic gel pen or fountain pen handwriting with natural pressure variation, lighter entry strokes, stronger main strokes, tapered endings, and slight ink irregularity. Letters may merge, stretch, overlap, simplify, share strokes, or become partially abstract. The goal is signature design, not perfect letter-by-letter readability.

FLOW: Create a graceful, fluid signature with smooth connected strokes and one or two long sweeping tails. Keep it elegant, natural, and believable as a real personal signature.

EDGE: Create a sharper, more directional signature using stronger slant, tall vertical accents, pointed turns, crossings, and decisive endings. Make it modern, confident, and fashion-forward.

LOOP: Build the signature around a large expressive looping gesture. Compress parts of the name inside or across the loop, and allow one stroke to extend outward as a strong finishing motion. Keep the loop organic and handwritten rather than geometrically perfect.

MARK: Create the most minimal and abstract version. Reduce the name to approximately 4–6 important strokes, often using the initials or strongest letter shapes as the foundation. The result may resemble a personal monogram or creator mark more than fully readable handwriting.

For softer or more romantic names, MARK may be replaced with CHARM: a refined usable signature with one subtle personal detail, such as a tiny heart-like terminal or a minimal floral gesture. Keep it tasteful and mature.

The four designs must feel clearly different at first glance. FLOW should feel fluid, EDGE sharp, LOOP expressive, and MARK minimal.

Keep each signature large enough to dominate its quadrant. Do not add extra descriptions under the style labels.

Do not add watermarks, numbering, decorative borders, stars, crowns, excessive hearts, unrelated icons, or unnecessary graphic elements.

Prompt:
Create a 10-second ultra-realistic UGC product commercial in vertical 9:16 format featuring a portable black GOTO “Kipas Angin Portable” fan. Keep the product design, buttons, handle, proportions, and packaging visually consistent throughout all scenes. Style: satisfying, realistic, clean lifestyle aesthetic, soft natural lighting, macro product details, smooth camera movements, shallow depth of field. ASMR only — no music, no voice-over.

Scene 1 — 0.0–0.9s:
Macro close-up of the GOTO Kipas Angin Portable product box held by a person's hands. Slowly move the camera closer to the packaging. Capture realistic cardboard texture and subtle finger rubbing sounds.

Scene 2 — 0.9–1.7s:
Top-down shot. Hands gently open the cardboard box and lift the portable fan from its packaging. Show realistic plastic crinkle and cardboard-opening sounds.

Scene 3 — 1.7–2.5s:
Flat-lay shot of the complete package contents neatly arranged on a clean wooden table: portable fan, USB cable, accessories, and instruction manual. Hands lightly tap the products.

Scene 4 — 2.5–3.3s:
Extreme close-up of the fan's front grille and control panel. Fingers gently touch and tap the buttons, showing the product details sharply and realistically.

Scene 5 — 3.3–4.1s:
Close-up of the practical leather-style carrying handle. A hand gently lifts and touches the handle, demonstrating its portability and sturdy construction.

Scene 6 — 4.1–5.0s:
Close-up top view. Slowly pour water into the built-in water tank for the spray/humidifying function. Capture realistic flowing-water and tiny splash sounds.

Scene 7 — 5.0–5.9s:
Macro close-up of a finger pressing the control button. The fan turns on and the speed mode changes. Capture a soft mechanical click and subtle fan-starting sound.

Scene 8 — 5.9–6.8s:
Close-up of the fan operating in spray/humidifier mode. A fine, soft mist visibly comes out while the fan runs. Show realistic airflow and delicate mist movement.

Scene 9 — 6.8–7.7s:
Side-angle shot showing stronger airflow from the fan. Use a lightweight tissue or thin fabric in front of the fan to visibly demonstrate the airflow. Show three speed levels through smooth transitions.

Scene 10 — 7.7–8.6s:
Medium lifestyle shot. The compact fan is placed beside a sofa on a modern table, showing how easily it fits into a home environment and can be moved around.

Scene 11 — 8.6–10.0s:
Premium beauty product shot. Place the portable fan neatly on a clean minimalist table with a soft modern living-room background and a small plant. Slow cinematic push-in toward the product, ending with a clean hero shot.

Visual & Technical Direction:
Ultra-realistic product photography, 4K/8K detail, realistic hands, natural skin texture, soft daylight, cinematic depth of field, clean minimalist background, accurate product proportions, smooth transitions, macro close-ups, subtle handheld UGC feel, realistic shadows and reflections.

Audio:
Pure ASMR: cardboard sounds, plastic crinkles, finger taps, button clicks, water pouring, soft mechanical fan sound, gentle airflow and mist sounds, subtle room ambience. No music and no voice-over.

Important: Keep the same fan, same design, same color, same handle, and same visual identity in every scene. No random text, no distorted product, no extra objects, no logo changes, no flickering, and no unnatural hand movements.

Trying a new logo structure for GPT 2.5. I tested it with scientists because I wanted to see how it can handle unusual topics. 

Prompt: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 famous scientists: WITH semantic_model AS (     SELECT         derive_short_token([TOPIC])                 AS token,         infer_iconic_object([TOPIC])                AS target_object,         infer_visual_archetype([TOPIC])             AS archetype ),  glyph_model AS (     SELECT         glyph,         analyze_stems(glyph)                        AS stems,         analyze_curves(glyph)                       AS curves,         analyze_counters(glyph)                     AS counters,         analyze_terminals(glyph)                    AS terminals     FROM letters(token) ),  object_model AS (     SELECT         decompose_axis(target_object)                AS axis,         decompose_head(target_object)                AS head,         decompose_body(target_object)                AS body,         decompose_terminal(target_object)            AS terminal,         decompose_negative_space(target_object)      AS voids )  SELECT render FROM symbolic_identity_archive WHERE mark_type = 'word-object fusion monogram' AND token = semantic_model.token AND object = semantic_model.target_object AND construction = optimize_shared_geometry(     glyph_model,     object_model ) AND palette = 'black on white' AND style = 'minimal heraldic-industrial typographic symbol' AND ornamentation = 'only structurally necessary' ORDER BY     dual_readability DESC,     silhouette_strength DESC,     stroke_economy DESC,     memorability DESC LIMIT 1;

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / DRINK]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [TWIST / SNAP / DRIP / PEEL / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European food branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the food and typography as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction should visibly alter the structure, surface, or material behavior of the letterforms through clear and believable physics.

Examples: TWIST, long food elements wrap around, pass in front of and behind, tighten around, and subtly pull selected letter strokes; SNAP, the food fractures along a clear force line and the typography breaks along the same continuous axis with small structural offsets; DRIP, a real liquid or glaze flows over the letters, gradually covering and replacing parts of the geometric type with edible material; PEEL, the surface of a letter is physically removed to reveal a different edible material underneath, with the peeled layer remaining visibly connected and curling away.

Keep the interaction focused on one main physical mechanism, localized deformations should follow real contact, weight, tension, gravity, viscosity, fracture, or material separation, untouched areas of the typography should remain clean, hard, geometric, and readable, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, floating food pieces, or digital-looking distortion.

Use a broken editorial grid with strong scale contrast, asymmetric placement, edge information, large negative space, and small meaningful annotations such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], avoid traditional menu rows, long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, and template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final image should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and immediately understandable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal how the food has physically changed the typography.

prompts.text:
和女朋友逛超市，你要买什么？

GPT IMAGE2 提示词：
9:16 竖版，写实真人摄影 × 山姆会员商店生活抓拍 × CCD 轻复古质感 × INS 都市日常。一位 18–20 岁、明确成年的漂亮东亚女性，拥有高颜值真人五官，小头、小脸，脸型纤细精致，黑色长发自然垂落至腰部附近。身材纤细修长，腰身明显，双腿修长，肌肤非常白皙、通透，呈干净细腻的冷白瓷肌色调。

人物身穿白色或浅灰色超短款深 V 低领背心，短款衣长停留在胸廓下方，完整露出纤细腰腹；正面采用明显的大深 V 剪裁。下身搭配蓝色低腰牛仔热裤，裤长非常短，采用低腰、短裤腿与自然毛边设计，贴合腰臀曲线，后侧裤脚采用较高开口剪裁，自然展现臀腿交界与修长腿部，同时保持牛仔热裤完整、真实的服装结构。

镜头改为从人物身后约 30–45° 的斜后方拍摄。 摄影机位于模特背后稍偏一侧，人物背部、纤细腰线、低腰牛仔热裤与修长双腿成为主要身体轮廓。

人物正在推着购物车向前行走，身体保持朝向超市货架方向，随后自然回头越过肩膀看向身后的镜头。头部与肩膀轻微回转，但腰胯仍保持向前，使背影与回眸面容同时进入画面，形成明显的“向前走 + 突然回头看摄影者”的生活抓拍瞬间。

回头时完整露出人物侧正面五官，眼神自然落向镜头，嘴角带一点慵懒、俏皮的淡淡笑意。黑色长发随着回头动作轻轻甩向一侧，部分长发自然铺在背部，避免头发遮挡眼睛和主要五官。

一只手自然握住购物车把手继续向前推，另一只手可以拿着刚从货架取下的商品、轻搭购物车边缘或自然垂落。肩膀一前一后，腰部随着回眸动作产生轻微自然扭转，一条腿正在向前迈步，使腰臀、腿部和整体身体形成自然流畅的动态 S 型线条。

场景位于真实山姆会员商店内部，背景可见高大的仓储式货架、大包装商品、冰柜、购物车与少量正在选购商品的顾客。货架向远处延伸形成明显纵深，环境宽敞、明亮、真实且具有生活气息。

采用 9:16 竖版斜后方全身抓拍构图，摄影机距离适当拉远，确保从人物完整头顶、回眸面容、长发、裸露腰部、低腰牛仔热裤、完整双腿一直到脚部全部进入画面。人物可略偏离画面中心，使前方购物车和货架自然形成视觉引导线。

镜头高度约位于人物腰部至胸部之间，采用轻微低机位的斜后方跟拍视角，模拟朋友拿着手机跟在人物身后逛超市时突然拍下的一瞬间。使用约 35–50mm 自然焦段视觉，避免严重广角导致臀部、腿部或脚部比例异常放大。

prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Max Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese 2D anime action-comedy with synchronized sound. Use the selected output aspect ratio.

STORY
A summons a threatening formation of metal swords and launches them at B. B raises a large red horseshoe magnet. The swords veer toward it and stick together in a noisy pile. End on A, still holding her attack pose, silently stunned by the empty sky.
REFERENCE / ROLE LOCK
A = character reference image 1 + voice reference audio 1. A is the caster, stands screen-left, summons the swords and appears in the final reaction close-up.
B = character reference image 2 + voice reference audio 2. B stands screen-right, holds the magnet and calmly collects the swords.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and art styles. Use references for identity and style only, not poses, backgrounds or reference-sheet layouts.
Keep these roles throughout. Only A casts magic. Only B holds the magnet. Neither character changes identity between shots.

VOICE
Exactly ONE spoken sentence:
A says 「にげばは、ない！」 once at 0.3-2.5s, using voice 1's identity, timbre and natural pitch range with accurate lip sync.
Read the hiragana as written. Finish before 3.0s. Audio references define voices, not scripts; never replay recorded words.
B is completely silent. Voice reference 2 belongs to B but produces no vocals.
After 3.0s, ZERO character voices: no additional dialogue, narration, inner monologue, gasps, grunts, screams, laughter or vocal breaths.
Continue sound effects and instrumental music as specified.
VISUAL STYLE / STAGING
High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime: clean linework, cel shading, fluid action and expressive faces.
Exactly two characters in a broad stone courtyard. A screen-left, B screen-right, about eight meters apart. Establish clear empty space between them. Maintain positions and screen direction across cuts.
A's summoned swords occupy the open air above the gap, initially closer to A. Keep them separate and readable against the sky.
PROPS / CONTINUITY
Use EIGHT summoned swords: solid silver metal blades with simple dark hilts. They are physical objects with visible weight and reflections, not beams or flat energy symbols.
The same eight swords remain visible through summoning, flight and collection. No new swords appear after the initial formation.
B uses ONE large, familiar U-shaped horseshoe magnet: red curved body, two silver pole tips, no writing or symbols. About shoulder-width, held securely by its curved base.
The magnet is separate from B's costume and does not emerge from her body. She brings it into view from behind her hip.
Its open ends face screen-left and angle slightly upward toward the approaching swords. Hold it in front of and slightly away from B's torso, below her face.
Only the summoned swords are collected. Reference costume pieces and sheathed accessories remain in place.
Sword blades attach flat against the pole tips and against one another. They form a visible metal bundle OUTSIDE the magnet, never disappearing inside it. Preserve individual hilts and blades rather than morphing them into a solid blob.
No sword strikes either character. Keep B's face and hands unobstructed.
0.0-4.0s — NO ESCAPE
Dramatic low-angle wide shot.
A speaks her single line, raises one hand and summons eight swords in a staggered formation above the courtyard.
Brief violet summoning light fades to reveal real silver blades. Their tips rotate together toward B.
A holds a commanding pose with a confident, closed-mouth smile. B watches calmly.
Use intense instrumental battle music, a magical surge and a clear metallic shimmer. No choir or vocal samples.
4.0-6.5s — THE ORDINARY SOLUTION
Medium shot of B. She reaches behind her hip and brings the large red horseshoe magnet fully into view.
Both hands support its curved base. She presents the open pole tips toward screen-left, below her face.
Pause briefly so the audience recognizes the ordinary magnet. The swords stay in formation until A gives the launch gesture.
Cut back to the original wide view with A, B, all eight swords and the magnet visible.
A sharply extends her casting hand. The swords launch across the open gap toward B.

6.5-9.0s — ALL CONFISCATED
Show the interception in ONE continuous wide shot.
As the swords approach, their trajectories visibly bend toward the magnet's two silver tips, away from B's body.
The swords swivel so their flat metal sides meet the poles. They arrive in rapid, staggered succession over roughly one second.
Use a brisk sequence of distinct metallic clanks, ending with one heavier clatter. Stop the music at the FIRST contact.
All eight swords stick to the magnet, with clear overlap and separate hilts.
Keep their flight fast and purposeful, with short motion trails. No slow floating, teleportation, explosion or cut hiding the capture.
B remains planted and calm, both hands holding the magnet. The sky becomes completely empty of swords.
9.0-12.0s — NOTHING LEFT TO FIRE
Hold a readable two-shot.
B steadies the magnet and its attached sword bundle. A small final metal rattle, then stillness.
A remains screen-left with her attack hand extended. She looks from the empty formation above her to the collected swords beside B.
Her confident smile disappears. Her hand hangs uselessly in the same commanding pose.
B gives A a quiet, neutral look. No triumphant speech or exaggerated grin.
Do not launch, drop or detach any sword.
12.0-15.0s — SILENT DISBELIEF
Cut to a close-up of A, the SAME caster from the opening.
Eyes widen, pupils shrink, eyebrows rise. Her lips part slightly once and remain still.
Hold her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
Use a short controlled push-in. Hold the final full second with faint courtyard ambience only.
End directly on A. No talking mouth, explanation, cut back, second attack or extra gag.
EXCLUSIONS
No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD or end card.
No photorealism, 3D-rendered look, chibi redesign, swapped roles, extra characters, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, costume changes, bodily transformation, injury, blood or canned laughter.

prompts.text:
prompt：https://promptsref.com/prompt/crouching-woman-under-a-blue-umbrella-compact-camera-grain-079faf83a701251903e7d88415032700

A realistic rainy-day street portrait with the visual language of an early-2000s Japanese independent magazine photograph and a low-resolution compact digital camera. Use a narrow approximately 9:16 vertical frame. A clearly adult young woman is facing the camera while crouching extremely low on rain-soaked asphalt or concrete. Both feet are planted apart, her knees are deeply bent and naturally opened to either side, her center of gravity dropped close to the ground. Her shoulders curl inward slightly, her head is lowered, and one or both hands hold a thin umbrella shaft near the center of her body. The pose should not feel like professional fashion posing; it should look as though she had already been crouching beside the puddle for a while.

She has very dark black, medium-to-long straight hair with dense heavy bangs falling over the upper eye area. The side sections hang beside her cheeks and shoulders. Humid rainy air has made the hair slightly damp, heavy and low-volume, with a few naturally clumped strands. She quietly looks toward the lens from beneath the shadow of her bangs; because her head is lowered, the eyes feel subtly raised toward the camera. Her expression is restrained, unsmiling, slightly tired and detached, carrying the emotional residue of a private pause. Keep the facial details soft and imperfect rather than sharpening them into a standardized commercial beauty face. Makeup follows a muted Japanese street-editorial language: cool fair natural base, subtle dark definition around the eyes or fine eyeliner, and muted berry-red to dark-red lips.

She wears a loose matte-black short-sleeved top or short black one-piece garment, paired with black shorts or another short dark bottom partially hidden beneath the oversized upper layer. No visible logos or bright graphics. The black fabric absorbs most of the available light so the clothing and dark hair merge into one compact shadow-like shape. Add chunky black shoes or short black boots.

Visible skin is limited mainly to the face, a small amount of neck, portions of the forearms and elbows, both knees, and short sections of the legs surrounding the knees. The chest, abdomen, waist, back, shoulders and buttocks remain covered. Skin is fair to light rather than porcelain white, with a subtle cool cast from the cloudy sky and reflected blue umbrella. Preserve faint pores, natural tonal variation and slightly more texture around the knees. The skin should visually suggest something soft and cool to the touch after sitting in humid rainy air, never waxy or aggressively airbrushed.

Above her is a large saturated blue umbrella occupying most of the top of the frame, serving as the strongest color identity in the photograph. Dark umbrella ribs and a thin shaft remain visible. The umbrella blocks part of the overhead skylight, leaving the face and black hair slightly darker while casting only a faint cyan-blue environmental spill onto the hair, face and shoulders.

The most important compositional feature is a broad shallow puddle directly below the subject. A large portion of the lower half of the image is devoted to her full reflection. The real figure occupies the upper half and the reflected figure occupies the lower half, forming an almost vertically mirrored two-part composition. The reflected body, legs, dark clothes and umbrella should broadly align with the real subject, but never look like a perfect Photoshop duplicate. Include subtle water distortion, small ripples, softness, brightness variation and irregular wet-pavement reflections.

Use a natural 35–50mm full-frame-equivalent lens feel without obvious ultra-wide distortion. Place the camera very low, approximately around the knee height of the crouching subject or slightly lower, shooting almost straight ahead with a very mild upward axis. Keep the complete crouching figure in the upper portion of the frame, but do not center everything mathematically. Allow slight framing drift, imperfect edge spacing and casual human composition. Depth of field is moderately shallow: the woman remains recognizable but never razor sharp, while pale gray-white buildings, the road and scattered green vegetation in the distance dissolve into soft blur.

Use only real overcast rainy-day illumination. A thick cloud-covered open sky acts as a broad, cool gray-white, nearly directionless light source. The umbrella blocks part of that top light, while the wet ground gives only extremely weak cool reflected fill from below. No flash, no artificial rim light, no three-point studio lighting.

Image texture should resemble an early consumer compact digital camera, inexpensive point-and-shoot, or low-resolution film scan: mild missed focus, soft atmospheric haze, fine grain, limited dynamic range, slight color cast and gentle underexposure. Allow subtle moisture haze on the lens, uneven ground reflections and softer edges than modern digital photography.

The rain had been heavier only moments ago. She had already been crouching there when she briefly lifted her eyes toward the camera. A second later she might stand and leave, while the other version of her would still tremble softly in the puddle. The final image should feel quiet, cold, damp, slightly melancholic and privately observed—not polished commercial photography.

Negative prompt: studio lighting, hard flash, HDR, ultra sharp, plastic skin, over-retouched skin, sunny weather, dry pavement, missing reflection, perfect digital reflection, fisheye, extreme wide angle, neon rim light, runway pose, anime face, oversaturated colors, clean commercial photography.

prompts.text:
Google Nano Banana 2

Prompt 👇

Create a realistic cinematic portrait of a girl in nature during the golden hour. Individual facial features. Healthy and smooth skin. Natural makeup, black eyelashes, natural pink-nude lips - looking natural. She is standing in a field with tall green grass and small yellow wildflowers, slightly turned sideways to the camera. Her head is gently tilted as a moment of pleasure and enjoyment of nature, her expression is calm and gentle, her eyes are softly closed (enjoying nature). Her hair is shiny and loose, illuminated by the sun, with a slight movement of the hair from the wind. Background: a wide summer field, a forest line in the distance, a beautiful sunset with warm golden and pink-orange light, soft clouds in the sky, atmospheric glow of the sun behind her back. Lighting is warm, soft, volumetric, with beautiful rim lighting on the hair and shoulders. Her skin looks natural. Clothing: a light loose cotton shirt in fine yellow and white stripes, neat and natural, without logos. Style - romantic, summer, minimalist. Composition: portrait from chest or waist, she is located slightly off-center, depth of field like on a professional camera. The frame looks like a high-quality lifestyle photograph taken with an 85mm lens, f/1.8, natural colors, high detail, soft bokeh, realistic perspective. Atmosphere: warm, calm, gentle, natural, a feeling of a summer evening, freedom and harmony. The photo should look like a real professional photo shoot, not like an artificially generated image. A live photo from a personal archive. Bright pink-orange summer sunset. Aspect ratio 9:16

prompts.text:
4 classic cars visualized with Nano Banana 2.1. Interesting experiment. I asked GPT to rate the images. The first one was 9/10, 2nd 8.5, 3rd one 5.5 and 4th one 4.5.   So it seems accuracy drifted by the 4th panel. 

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 strange vehicle concepts that were real: <instruction> Input A is a car photograph, vehicle model, or automotive topic that is researched. RUN_ID: [INSERT A NEW INTEGER FOR EACH RUN] You are a god-tier automotive advertising director, transportation photographer, poster designer, and print-production specialist. PHASE 1 — THREE-WAY AUTOMOTIVE SYNTHESIS Store the following values in zero-indexed arrays. $ AutoMovementArray[0..14] = [ International Typographic Automotive Poster, Italian Futurist Speed Manifesto, 1970s European Racing Advertisement, Japanese 1980s Performance-Car Brochure, German Modernist Engineering Campaign, American Muscle-Car Magazine Advertisement, Neo-Noir Luxury Automobile Campaign, Contemporary Minimalist EV Launch, Cyberpunk Street-Racing Promotion, Art Deco Grand Touring Advertisement, Brutalist Motorsport Poster, Pop-Art Consumer Car Campaign, Swiss Luxury Watch-Inspired Automotive Layout, Cinematic Supercar Billboard, Experimental Transportation Museum Poster ] $ AutoGraphicArray[0..14] = [ Extreme Low-Angle Hero Photography, Technical Cutaway Overlay, Wind-Tunnel Streamline Graphics, Oversized Condensed Typography, Racing Number and Livery System, Diagonal Speed-Line Composition, Exploded Mechanical Components, Track-Map Geometry, Chrome Reflection Typography, Editorial Specification Grid, Motion-Blur Light Trails, Blueprint Measurement Callouts, Panoramic Billboard Cropping, Carbon-Fiber Texture Fields, Performance Data Telemetry ] Select THREE distinct automotive movements and THREE distinct graphic systems using the Universal Selection Logic. $ MovementSelection = combination_unrank( $ AutoMovementArray, 3, (($ RUN_ID * 7) + 1) % 455 ) $ GraphicSelection = combination_unrank( $ AutoGraphicArray, 3, (($ RUN_ID * 11) + 5) % 455 ) Apply 60/30/10 weighting to both selections. PHASE 2 — CAMPAIGN CONCEPT Generate: $ CAMPAIGN_NAME $ HEADLINE $ TAGLINE $ SELECTION_SIGNATURE The identity must sell speed, engineering, handling, desirability, or prestige without becoming a random collage. PHASE 3 — VISUAL RENDERING Generate a 2:1 horizontal automotive campaign asset sheet.   FINISHED ADVERTISEMENT: Create a premium launch advertisement based on Input A. Preserve the exact vehicle model, recognizable body proportions, wheel placement, lighting direction, camera perspective, and major scene geometry when a reference photograph is supplied. Use: Movement 1 as the dominant campaign language. Movement 2 as the supporting historical or cultural language. Movement 3 only as a controlled accent. Use the same hierarchy for the three graphic systems. Include: The generated headline. One concise tagline. A small vehicle or campaign name. Professional negative space. Believable print-production detail. Automotive-commercial lighting. No fictional manufacturer logo unless requested. No malformed wheels, lights, body panels, or reflections.  OUTPUT: 16:9. High-end automotive advertising. Sharp body geometry. Production-ready composition. No duplicate selections within either pool. </instruction>

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a 9:16 retro-tech editorial poster.

Subject: [DEVICE OR MEDIA]
Headline: [MAIN TITLE]
Secondary copy: [SHORT TAGLINE]
Accent color: [ONE COLOR]

Use a clean warm off-white background with one realistic retro digital object as the main visual anchor. Combine 1990s–2000s technology-magazine aesthetics, Neo-Swiss editorial grids, industrial product manuals, and early-digital culture.

Make the headline oversized and structural rather than simply placed above the product. Let the device, media, cable, tape, disc, cartridge, or flash interact physically with the typography through overlap, transparency, cropping, or foreground/background relationships.

Keep the palette restrained: warm white, black, transparent gray or metallic tones, plus one strong accent color. Add meaningful technical information related to the subject, such as storage data, playback controls, exposure settings, save progress, audio tracks, timestamps, diagrams, small labels, grids, barcodes, and micro typography.

Build clear hierarchy: hero object first, bold typography second, graphic interaction third, technical details last. Keep the layout information-rich but organized, with intentional negative space and a precise editorial grid.

Use realistic plastic, glass, metal, circuitry, screens, buttons, and mechanical details. Add only subtle print and scan texture. The technology can feel retro, but the poster itself should remain clean and contemporary.

Avoid real brand logos, random filler text, heavy grunge, distressed typography, neon cyberpunk, excessive colors, futuristic HUD graphics, sparkle symbols, and generic ecommerce composition.

prompts.text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt [Part 1]
Create a 30-second action-comedy with synchronized audio: Part 1 of a 60-second story. Use the selected aspect ratio. Show an enormous sword attack within three seconds against one ordinary mosquito.

REFERENCES
A = the black-haired heroine from @Image 1.
B = the white-haired heroine from @Image 2.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories, proportions and 2D anime art styles. Appearance references only; new poses and environment.
@Audio 1 supplies A's voice timbre only, not its recorded words. B has no voice reference and produces no vocal sound.
Each heroine has one katana. Preserve any weapon design visible in her reference.
LOOK AND CONTINUITY
Photorealistic Shibuya scramble crossing at dusk. Dense buildings, realistic asphalt, glass and concrete. Keep the heroines hand-drawn 2D anime with clean lines, cel shading and matching environmental lighting.
The streets are empty. The only characters are A, B and one small mosquito with a thin dark body, long legs and transparent wings.
The mosquito stays naturally small; use close-ups to show it. It escapes immediately before each attack.
Show clear cause and effect: sword movement, traveling energy, then destruction where the energy strikes. Damage accumulates. A stays unharmed.
Readable cuts and grounded footwork. Alternate insect close-ups, medium action shots and wide destruction shots.
Shot 1 [0-3s] — A TINY TARGET, A HUGE ATTACK
Extreme close-up: the mosquito rests on A's cheek, buzzing. A narrows her eyes. It takes off before she moves her sword.
Hard cut to a low-angle medium-wide shot. A swings her already-drawn katana outward, away from her face. A brilliant teal crescent follows the blade and races down the empty street, splitting the asphalt into a long trench.
A speaks once in Japanese between 1.0 and 1.7 seconds, using @Audio 1:
{そこだ！}
Accurate lip sync. Close her mouth afterward.
<Close mosquito buzz, sharp sword rush, pavement cracking>
(Instrumental action score: urgent percussion and low strings, no vocals.)
Shot 2 [3-9s] — THE FIRST MISS
Close-up of the mosquito changing direction just before the blade reaches its flight path.
Side-tracking medium shot: A takes one quick forward step and makes a horizontal cut. Follow the teal crescent into the background, where it shears through an empty building facade. Glass and concrete burst outward after impact.
Wide shot of the new damage; the mosquito crosses the foreground unharmed.
<Sword whoosh, glass breaking, heavy debris impacts>
Shot 3 [9-15s] — THE SECOND MISS
A notices the mosquito hovering ahead. Medium three-quarter shot: she plants her front foot, turns her shoulders and makes one rising diagonal cut.
The mosquito darts sideways first. A tall teal arc strikes a different building behind it, cutting a bright diagonal line through the structure. The damaged upper section tilts and collapses away from A.
Cut briefly to the mosquito hovering beside a falling dust grain, then back to A's increasingly irritated eyes.
<Escalating blade rush, structural crack, distant collapse>
No dialogue or vocal reaction.
Shot 4 [15-20s] — OVERKILL
Low-angle full-body shot. A grips the katana with both hands and makes one forceful downward cut.
A tall teal energy wave tears farther down the road. A wide shot shows a deeper trench and another burst of rubble. Keep the energy's path visible before impact; retain all earlier damage.
A finishes planted, sword controlled. The score reaches its final accent.
<One powerful energy rush, concrete rupture, rolling debris>

Shot 5 [20-26s] — THE MOSQUITO WINS
Cut to A, looking satisfied as dust drifts behind her. Stop the music.
The same mosquito emerges from the dust and lands on the tip of her nose.
Close-up: A's eyes slowly turn inward toward it. Her proud expression freezes into silent disbelief. She holds still rather than swinging at her face.
<One clearly audible mosquito buzz; faint settling rubble>
No dialogue, gasp or vocal breath.
Shot 6 [26-30s] — REINFORCEMENTS
Medium-wide shot. B walks in from screen-right and stops beside A, holding her own drawn katana.
A remains screen-left, B screen-right. Both stand on intact ground at the center of the damaged crossing.
The mosquito lifts off A's nose and hovers ahead. A and B turn toward it, settling into ready stances without attacking.
End on a stable two-shot with the damaged intersection, ready to continue.
AUDIO AND EXCLUSIONS
Only A's scripted line in Shot 1. B is silent throughout. After 2s, no voices, grunts, screams, gasps, laughter or vocal breaths.
Specified effects and instrumental score only. No narration, choir, subtitles, readable text, logos, watermarks or HUD.
No extra people, clones, extra mosquitoes, monsters, giant insects, face swaps, costume changes, realistic character faces, extra limbs, fused hands, floating swords, injury, city restoration or prolonged whiteout.

Seedance 2.5 Prompt [Part 2]
Extend @Video 1 by 30 seconds from its final frame. New events only, no replay. Part 2 of the action-comedy; times refer to the NEW segment.

REFERENCES
@Video 1 supplies opening composition, positions, lighting and accumulated city damage.
A = the black-haired heroine from @Image 1.
B = the white-haired heroine from @Image 2.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories, proportions and 2D anime art styles. Appearance references only; no reference-sheet layouts.
@Audio 1 supplies A's voice timbre only. Never replay reference dialogue.
B has no voice reference and remains completely silent.
One katana per heroine. B carries one ordinary electric mosquito racket secured behind her back. Reveal this temporary prop in the final gag.
LOOK AND CONTINUITY
Same empty, photorealistic Shibuya crossing at dusk; anime heroines with clean lines, cel shading and matching lighting.
A screen-left, B screen-right, on the intact central patch from @Video 1. Preserve all prior damage.
One naturally small mosquito from @Video 1. Use close-ups to show it.
A's energy is teal; B's violet. Attack forward, away from each other. Show energy reaching buildings before destruction.
Shot 1 [0-3s] — TWO AGAINST ONE
Continue the final two-shot from @Video 1. The mosquito hovers ahead of the heroines.
A and B raise their katanas. Blade edges glow teal and violet.
A speaks once in Japanese between 0.5 and 1.8 seconds, using @Audio 1:
{こんどこそ！}
Accurate lip sync. A closes her mouth afterward. B's lips remain closed.
<Teal and violet magical hums, mosquito buzz>
(Instrumental battle score resumes with brisk percussion and rising strings.)
Shot 2 [3-9s] — COORDINATED COMBAT
Close-up: the mosquito darts forward between their attack paths.
Medium-wide shot: A steps left and makes a diagonal cut. B steps right and follows with a horizontal cut toward the same area ahead. Readable bodies and blade paths; their swords never touch.
Teal and violet crescents cross down the street, shattering two damaged facades. Debris flies away from the heroines.
Cut to the mosquito emerging unharmed into the foreground.
<Two distinct sword rushes, two successive building impacts>
No dialogue or vocal reaction.
Shot 3 [9-15s] — THE COMBINED FINISHER
Low-angle two-shot: both plant their feet and raise their swords. A brief teal-and-violet charge lifts their hair and costume edges. Keep faces, hands and weapons visible.
One synchronized swing. Their two arcs visibly join into one enormous teal-and-violet wave.
The mosquito changes direction before the wave reaches its previous position.
Follow the expanding wave toward the buildings.
<Rising energy resonance, one synchronized sword rush>
(The instrumental score reaches its strongest accent.)
Shot 4 [15-20s] — SHIBUYA BECOMES RUBBLE
High-angle wide shot: the wave strikes the surrounding blocks. Facades burst apart, towers fold outward and dust rolls across the streets. The blocks become a low rubble field; A and B's central patch stays intact. The wave fades to reveal the destruction.
Cut back to both heroines lowering their swords, apparently victorious.
<One enormous impact, successive concrete collapses, settling debris>
Stop music and magical hum as dust clears.
Shot 5 [20-23s] — STILL ALIVE
The same mosquito flies out of the dust unharmed and hovers near B. Rack focus from ruined street to insect.
A's confident expression disappears. B notices the mosquito calmly, mouth closed.
<One irritating mosquito buzz; faint distant rubble>
No dialogue or vocal reaction.
Shot 6 [23-26s] — THE NORMAL SOLUTION
Medium shot showing B's face, hand, racket and mosquito.
B holds her sword still in her left hand, pointed down. Her right hand retrieves the racket from behind her back: compact plastic frame, metal mesh, short handle.
One controlled wrist sweep. Show mesh contacting mosquito; only then one tiny blue spark. The mosquito disappears after contact.
B holds the racket still with her usual calm expression.
<One short, dry electrical zap>
The mosquito buzz stops. No explosion or comedy sting.

Shot 7 [26-30s] — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Brief two-shot: A looks across the flattened city, then at B's ordinary racket.
Close-up of A, preserving @Image 1's face.
Eyes wide, pupils small, eyebrows raised. Lips part slightly once, then remain still. Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
Use a short, controlled push-in. Hold her face for the final full second. B remains off-screen and silent.

End directly on A's face.
AUDIO AND EXCLUSIONS
Only A's scripted line in Shot 1. B is silent throughout. After 2s, no voices, grunts, screams, gasps, laughter or vocal breaths.
No narration, choir, subtitles, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD or end card.
No extra people, clones, extra mosquitoes, giant insects, face swaps, costume changes, realistic character faces, extra limbs, fused hands, duplicated weapons, injury, restored buildings or second racket strike.

B holds her sword still in her left hand, pointed down. Her right hand retrieves the racket from behind her back: compact plastic frame, metal mesh, short handle.
One controlled wrist sweep. Show mesh contacting mosquito; only then one tiny blue spark. The mosquito disappears after contact.
B holds the racket still with her usual calm expression.
<One short, dry electrical zap>
The mosquito buzz stops. No explosion or comedy sting.

Shot 7 [26-30s] — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Brief two-shot: A looks across the flattened city, then at B's ordinary racket.
Close-up of A, preserving @Image 1's face.
Eyes wide, pupils small, eyebrows raised. Lips part slightly once, then remain still. Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
Use a short, controlled push-in. Hold her face for the final full second. B remains off-screen and silent.

End directly on A's face.
AUDIO AND EXCLUSIONS
Only A's scripted line in Shot 1. B is silent throughout. After 2s, no voices, grunts, screams, gasps, laughter or vocal breaths.
No narration, choir, subtitles, readable text, logos, watermarks, HUD or end card.
No extra people, clones, extra mosquitoes, giant insects, face swaps, costume changes, realistic character faces, extra limbs, fused hands, duplicated weapons, injury, restored buildings or second racket strike.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【中文姓名】：{例如：林知夏}  
【姓名拼音】：{例如：LIN ZHIXIA}  
【顶部背景色】：{例如：深钴蓝、灰调珊瑚、鼠尾草绿、深酒红}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请将输入的普通中文姓名重新设计成一张完整的「中文个性签名 AI Filter」设计稿。最终画面为 9:16 竖版，上方约占 40%，展示普通印刷姓名；下方约占 60%，展示同一个名字的四种完全不同的艺术手写签名。整体高级、克制、现代、有专业设计提案感，不要像普通字体样张或书法练习纸。

【顶部姓名区】

使用【顶部背景色】作为主色，加入极轻微的纸张或织物质感，并可加入柔和自然的窗影、树影或建筑光影，但不要复杂。顶部中央使用很小、字距宽松的英文“NAME TO SIGNATURE”，中央使用暖象牙白色、规整优雅的中文宋体大字展示【中文姓名】，姓名下方以小字号、宽字距大写英文显示【姓名拼音】。

这里的中文姓名必须保持普通印刷字体，不要手写、连笔或艺术变形，用来明确表现“原始输入”。除此之外不要添加额外标语、解释文案、Logo、编号或装饰图形，保持充分留白，让姓名成为上半部分绝对视觉中心。

【底部签名区】

底部统一使用暖米白色纸张，只保留非常轻微的天然纸纹，不做明显做旧、污渍或强颗粒。使用非常浅、非常细的灰褐色虚线将区域分成 2×2 四格，不需要外边框。每一格只展示一个大尺寸黑色艺术签名，以及下方很小的风格名称：飘逸、锋势、回环、极简。

四个签名全部来源于同一个【中文姓名】，但在结构、方向、节奏、抽象程度、重心和视觉人格上必须有明显差异。不要只是将完整姓名用四种相似连笔方式重新写一遍。允许大胆省笔、合笔、共享笔画、连续连写、拉长、缩写、重构和符号化，不要求每个中文字都完整可辨，重点是从姓名中提炼具有个人识别度的签名结构。

签名使用自然黑色签字笔、钢笔或 gel pen 的真实手写质感，线条带自然笔压变化：起笔较细，主笔略重，转折处有自然压力，快速拖尾逐渐变细，局部允许极轻微断墨。不要生成完全光滑的数字矢量曲线，也不要做成传统毛笔书法。

【飘逸款】

将姓名设计成横向、轻盈、流畅的艺术签名。可以高度压缩中文字形，并让多个字符共享笔画、自然连写，通过一至两条大跨度长线或拖尾把整个姓名连接为完整手势。允许牺牲部分可读性，重点表现流动节奏、速度感和优雅气质。

最终效果应像艺人、设计师或创作者自然签出的成熟个人签名，而不是清楚书写的三个中文字。整体以柔和曲线和连续笔势为主，不要堆叠过多尖角。

【锋势款】

将姓名设计成更加锋利、快速、有力量的签名。大量使用斜线、尖角、高竖笔、快速切线和干脆的收笔，把中文字形高度压缩，只保留几个最有力量的骨架结构。

整体可以明显向右倾斜，形成强烈速度感和现代感。避免大面积柔软圆环，让这款和飘逸款第一眼就形成明显区别，气质偏冷静、果断、有气场。

【回环款】

将姓名设计成以大型回环结构为核心的艺术签名。可以使用开放圆环、自由椭圆、大 S 曲线、丝带式曲线或不规则包围结构，把高度压缩后的姓名笔势自然嵌入回环内部或让其穿过回环，并允许最后一笔突破主体结构形成长收尾。

回环必须具有真人快速书写的自然感，不能像规整几何图形。整体第一眼应更像一个艺术家的个人签名符号，第二眼才感受到它来自原始中文姓名。

【极简款】

这是四种方案中最抽象、最克制的一款。不需要完整写出整个姓名，只从中文字形中提取大约 4–6 个最有识别价值的主笔，例如长横、主竖、折笔、斜线或几个点笔，再重新组合成一个高级、容易记忆的个人视觉标记。

最终效果可以接近 Personal Mark、个人 Logo 或设计师签名。第一眼不要求直接认出完整姓名，但知道原始姓名以后，应能够理解这些笔势与原字结构的关系。保持大量留白，不要添加无关圆圈、箭头、星形或其他装饰符号。

【整体控制】

四款签名必须真正体现不同的人格：飘逸款强调柔长、流动和速度；锋势款强调锐利、力量和斜向结构；回环款强调艺术性、包围关系和图形感；极简款强调省笔、符号化和个人品牌感。

不要让四款只是同一种签名修改尾笔。最终签名既要具有艺术性和明显风格差异，也应保留真实手写感与一定的实际书写可能性。整张画面保持干净、高级、有编辑设计感，不添加 Logo、水印、编号、四角星芒、复杂边框或其他多余装饰元素。

生成一张 East Asian Editorial Design 风格的文化海报，使用“非均衡三分区构图”。

prompts.text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese anime action-comedy with synchronized dialogue and sound. Use the selected aspect ratio.

STORY
A unleashes a spectacular bowling throw. All ten pins jump over her ball and land upright, completely untouched. B then makes an ordinary throw at the SAME pins and scores a strike. End on A’s familiar stunned, uncomprehending face.
REFERENCES
@Image 1 = A, the black-haired heroine.
@Image 2 = B, the white-haired heroine.
Preserve each character’s exact face, hairstyle, costume, accessories, proportions and 2D art style. Use references for identity only, with new poses and scenery. Never mix designs or reproduce reference-sheet layouts.

@Audio 1 = A’s voice, only for A’s assigned sentence.
@Audio 2 = B’s voice, only for B’s assigned sentence.
Preserve their vocal identities and natural pitch ranges. Never replay the words recorded in the reference audio.
STYLE AND LOCATION
Expressive hand-drawn 2D anime heroines with clean linework, crisp cel shading and fluid movement, integrated into a photorealistic bowling alley.
Polished wooden lane, realistic gutters, metal fixtures and colorful overhead lighting. No readable signage or score display.
Exactly two characters, one active lane and one continuous location. No spectators.
A bowls first, then waits on the left side of the approach. B initially waits on the right, then steps into the same release position. Keep their identities and screen direction consistent.
Both balls travel away from the approach toward the pins. Neither character enters the lane.
PROPS AND CONTINUITY — HIGH PRIORITY
Exactly TEN ordinary white bowling pins with two red neck stripes, arranged in the standard triangular formation: rows of 1, 2, 3 and 4.
Pins have no faces, limbs or clothing. Their only supernatural action is ONE synchronized vertical jump during A’s throw.
All ten remain the same size and shape throughout.

A uses one normal-sized teal bowling ball.
B uses one normal-sized purple bowling ball.
A’s ball has a dramatic energy trail but remains a solid, recognizable bowling ball. B’s ball has no magic or energy effects.
Only one ball rolls on the lane at a time.
A’s ball passes beneath the airborne pins without touching them, then enters the rear pit.
All ten pins land upright in their ORIGINAL positions.
B bowls at this same untouched formation. No pin reset, replacement or extra pins between throws.
During B’s throw, the pins stay on the floor until her ball physically strikes them.
DIALOGUE
Exactly TWO spoken sentences:

At 0.1–0.8 seconds, A, using @Audio 1, says in Japanese {いっけー！}
Delivery: a confident, energetic battle shout.
At 6.0–6.7 seconds, B, using @Audio 2, says in Japanese {よいしょ。}
Delivery: casual and relaxed, making an ordinary bowling throw.
Accurate lip synchronization. Only the assigned speaker speaks.
No additional dialogue, narration, gasps, grunts, laughter or vocal reactions.
After 6.7 seconds, both characters remain vocally silent.
TIMELINE

0.0–1.5s — THE ULTIMATE BOWLING THROW
Begin with A already taking the final step of her bowling approach. No slow introduction or extended power-up.
Use a dynamic low three-quarter view showing A, her ball and the long lane ahead. B is visible waiting to the side.
A delivers her assigned sentence and releases the teal ball with one powerful underarm bowling swing.
Clearly show the ball leaving her hand and beginning to roll forward on the wood.
A brilliant teal energy ribbon follows the ball. A broad luminous shockwave sweeps along the lane edges, making the throw look absurdly powerful.
Keep the ball and its forward motion readable. Effects do not damage the lane or conceal the pins.
(Music: energetic instrumental battle music with driving percussion, no vocals.)
<Powerful release whoosh, fast bowling-ball rumble, short energy surge.>

1.5–4.5s — THE PINS DODGE
Cut to a low three-quarter side view near the far end of the lane, showing the ENTIRE ten-pin formation, the approaching ball and the rear pit.
Keep this shot UNINTERRUPTED through the jump, ball passage and landing.
The teal ball approaches rapidly.
Just before contact, ALL TEN pins jump straight upward together, approximately 60 centimeters.
Their spacing and upright orientation remain unchanged, like ten rigid objects making the same hop.
The ball continues rolling along the floor and passes visibly UNDER the entire airborne formation.
Show a clear gap between the ball and the pin bases. No collision.
The ball enters the rear pit.
Only AFTER the ball has completely cleared them do all ten pins descend and land upright in their original triangular positions.
One jump only. A short natural arc, no hovering or repeated bouncing.
Hold the perfectly intact formation briefly so the failed throw is unmistakable.
The energy trail fades without moving the pins.
Stop the battle music when the pins jump.

prompts.text:
真绝了！AI生图居然可以精准控图了！！

现在的生图模型已经越来越厉害了，但一直有个痛点没解决：
没办法精准控图！
因为排版这个东西，真的很难用“提示词”描述清楚，
有时候想修改排版只能反复抽卡！

最近发现模思智能开源的 MOSS-Image，居然真的解决了“修改排版”的问题！！
作为一个用国产算力平台训出来的“纯血国产模型”，效果真的很超预期，
参数只有5B（DiT 主干），支持最长 4K tokens 复杂提示词输入。
最6的是！它支持用 JSON Layout 结构化精准控图！

什么意思呢？
在生图时，可以直接从参数层面指定元素坐标框和方位参数，按照预设的排版，精准生图！
所以，现在商用生图可以用这一套工作流：
MOSS-Image-SFT → 输入布局 JSON → 导入布局 → 检查并拖动位置框 → 保存并应用 → 提交生成。

我拿它做了一张咖啡店的上新海报，然后直接调整 JSON 里的位置框和方位描述，海报上的指定元素就可以更改位置，整体换一种排版！！
做广告海报、电商产品图、社媒封面之类的图，直接可以在提示词里真正把「内容」和「位置」一起交代清楚了。

【主体特性】：展开 / 垂落 / 翻卷 / 分层 / 振动 / 投影 / 反射 / 其他
【档案信息】：结构 / 材料 / 尺寸 / 过程 / 局部样本 / 其他
【主题色】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 East Asian Editorial Design、Museum Poster 与文化出版物质感的竖版海报。

采用“非均衡三分构图”，让画面分别承担主视觉、标题文字和辅助档案信息，但不要平均切成三个区域，也不要出现明显分栏。

先分析【主视觉对象】最有辨识度的真实物理或材质特性，再让这种特性直接决定构图。例如展开产生放射、布料垂落与翻卷形成纵深、材料切面揭示内部层次、琴弦振动形成连续轨迹。不要机械套用案例，应根据当前对象重新寻找最合适的视觉动作。

主体必须占据较大的视觉权重，并跨越至少两个区域。通过遮挡、穿插、投影、翻卷、剖面、延伸、振动或其他真实空间关系，把主视觉、Typography 与信息区连接起来，而不是把三部分分别摆放。

设置一个醒目的【中文核心字】，使用现代高对比宋体 / 明朝体，使文字本身成为构图的一部分。允许主体穿过文字、文字跨越不同材质后发生黑白反转、影子覆盖文字或结构线进入字形负空间，但始终保证核心字清晰可读。

整体使用暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸作为基底，搭配墨黑文字和一个主要【主题色】。每张作品尽量只保留一个强强调色，纸张具有轻微纤维与哑光印刷质感，保持干净，不做严重旧化。

加入与主题真实相关的【档案信息】，例如材料、结构剖面、制作过程、尺寸、运动状态、局部微距或时间记录。小信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace，英文标题使用 Serif。所有文字都应服务作品主题，不使用 Design Study、Visual System、Vol.、Case 等模板占位词。

信息密度保持中高，但不要平均铺满。主视觉形成高密区，结构与档案形成中密区，同时保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，形成明显的密疏节奏。

最终阅读顺序：第一眼看到巨大主体与核心中文；第二眼发现主体跨区形成的空间或运动关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或制作过程；第四眼阅读作品标题和档案细节。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级与编辑气质，但每张根据不同【主体特性】重新设计三分方向、视觉动势和跨区方式，不做模板换皮。

避免：平均三栏、PPT 感、普通产品摆拍、满版图片加标题、随机小字、无意义英文、科技 HUD、过度做旧、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。
